source_refs.note: Topic 1.8.3, printed pages 15-16: the reactions with chlorine, with Quick Check 1.4 as the self-check.

blocks.text: Chlorine reacts with both metals to give soluble salts. It reacts exothermically with sodium, a golden yellow flame is seen and the white solid sodium chloride is formed: 2Na(s) + Cl2(g) gives 2NaCl(s). Magnesium also reacts with chlorine to give the white solid magnesium chloride: Mg(s) + Cl2(g) gives MgCl2(s).
